values.title: Secrets
values.summary: Store API keys and credentials per environment and read them safely in functions.
values.body:
## Setting a secret

Terminal

```
npx tessera secrets set STRIPE_KEY sk_live_… --env production
npx tessera secrets list --env production
```

## Reading a secret

TypeScript

```
export default fn(async ({ secrets }) => {
  const stripe = new Stripe(secrets.STRIPE_KEY)
})
```

Secrets are encrypted at rest, scoped to one environment and never included in logs.

Preview branches

Branches inherit secrets from the environment they were created from unless you override them.
